ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80:20 ratio of low-intensity dark pigment to high-intensity white/grey regions across visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black central region; high-intensity white/grey mottling localized to the distal margins and tips of both lobes; extreme high-contrast textured clusters at the terminal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression at central junction; apex partially obscured by water-line pixel noise.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the trailing edge; prominent jagged peak on the right lobe edge; distal tips show extreme irregular topography due to bio-fouling clusters.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve on the distal leading edges with a concave sweep on the trailing edges toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast, textured pixel clusters at the distal tips of both lobes; scattered circular white focal spots on the right lobe dark surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct diagonal white linear marks on the right lobe; multiple shorter unaligned white scratches visible on the central dark region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at both distal tips; numerous white rake-mark abrasions on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy textured barnacle masses creating significant structural deformation at the lobe terminals.
